mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_invoice_history (invoice_id, action_type, action_content, operator, action_time, created_at) VALUES (#{invoiceId}, #{actionType}, #{actionContent}, #{operator}, #{actionTime}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_invoice_history WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId} ORDER BY action_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_invoice_history WHERE action_type = #{actionType} ORDER BY action_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_invoice_history WHERE operator = #{operator} ORDER BY action_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_invoice_history WHERE action_time >= #{start} AND action_time <= #{end} ORDER BY action_time DESC
